## Providers

| Doc | What it's for |
|---|---|
| [alibaba](providers/alibaba/README.md) | Track Alibaba Coding Plan (Model Studio / Bailian) 5-hour, weekly and monthly quotas with an API key or console cookies. Use when setting up Alibaba or when it shows "Session expired". |
| [ampcode](providers/ampcode/README.md) | Track Amp Code free-tier dollars left and the individual credit balance by running `amp usage`. Use when setting up Amp or when it shows "No valid credit lines found". |
| [antigravity](providers/antigravity/README.md) | Track Antigravity's Gemini and Claude-and-others quota pools (5-hour and weekly) from the running app or `agy` CLI, or from your stored sign-in when the app is closed. Use when setting up Antigravity or when it shows an error. |
| [bedrock](providers/bedrock/README.md) | Track today's AWS Bedrock spend, token counts and per-model costs from CloudWatch, against an optional daily budget. Use when setting up Bedrock with an AWS profile or when it shows no data. |
| [claude](providers/claude/README.md) | Track Claude 5-hour session, weekly and per-model (Opus, Sonnet, Fable) limits plus Extra Usage spend, via `claude /usage` or the OAuth usage API. Use when setting up Claude or when it shows an error. |
| [cline](providers/cline/README.md) | Track your Cline plan's five-hour, weekly and monthly limits with a Cline API key or the login `cline auth` saved. Use when setting up Cline or when its key is rejected. |
| [cloudflare-ai](providers/cloudflare-ai/README.md) | Track a Cloudflare account's Workers AI neurons against 10k a day, Workers AI and AI Gateway tokens, the Workers Paid overage and the last invoice, with a read-only API token. Use when setting up Cloudflare AI. |
| [codex](providers/codex/README.md) | Track Codex 5-hour and weekly limits through the codex app-server RPC or the ChatGPT backend API. Use when setting up Codex or when it shows "—", stale numbers or an error. |
| [commandcode](providers/commandcode/README.md) | Track Command Code 5-hour and weekly limits and your monthly credit balance, from the same API the cmd CLI's /usage uses. Use when setting up Command Code or when it shows "Session expired". |
| [copilot](providers/copilot/README.md) | Track GitHub Copilot monthly AI credits through the GitHub Billing API or the Copilot internal API, using a personal access token. Use when setting up Copilot or when it shows no data on a Business or Enterprise plan. |
| [cursor](providers/cursor/README.md) | Track Cursor's monthly included usage, Auto and API when reported, on-demand spend and enterprise team credits, read with the sign-in the Cursor app already stores. Use when setting up Cursor or when it shows nothing, EMPTY or "Session expired". |
| [deepseek](providers/deepseek/README.md) | Track separate DeepSeek accounts and their paid/granted balances in CNY or USD. Set up API keys, rename accounts, or troubleshoot rejected keys. |
| [devin](providers/devin/README.md) | Track your Devin organization's daily and weekly quota with your app.devin.ai sign-in from the browser, or a pasted session token. Use when setting up Devin or when its sign-in stops working. |
| [gemini](providers/gemini/README.md) | Track Gemini Code Assist quota per model tier (Pro, Flash, Flash Lite) using the Gemini CLI's Google sign-in. Use when setting up Gemini or when it shows "Authentication required" or 100% everywhere. |
| [grok](providers/grok/README.md) | Track Grok (xAI Grok Build) credit usage for the current billing period, per-product limits and on-demand spend, using the grok CLI's sign-in. Use when setting up Grok or when it shows "Session expired". |
| [jetbrains](providers/jetbrains/README.md) | Track your JetBrains AI credits for the month from the quota your JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, Android Studio, …) saves locally. Use when setting up JetBrains AI or when it asks you to sign in. |
| [kimi](providers/kimi/README.md) | Track Kimi Code plan and 5-hour limits through the interactive kimi CLI or the Kimi web billing API. Use when setting up Kimi or when it shows "No quota data found" or "Key needed". |
| [kiro](providers/kiro/README.md) | Track Kiro monthly plan credits and bonus credits by running `kiro-cli` and reading its `/usage` output. Use when setting up Kiro or when it shows nothing or "No quota data found in Kiro CLI output". |
| [minimax](providers/minimax/README.md) | Track MiniMax Token Plan usage left per model, with an API key, on the International (minimax.io) or China (minimaxi.com) platform. Use when setting up MiniMax or when it shows an auth or HTTP error. |
| [mistral](providers/mistral/README.md) | Show today's and yesterday's Mistral Vibe cost and token totals from Vibe's local session logs, plus the Vibe Coding Plan's percent used and reset time from chat.mistral.ai with a session cookie. Use when setting up Mistral or when its card is empty. |
| [omp](providers/omp/README.md) | Track the rate-limit windows of every account Oh My Pi (omp) is signed into via `omp usage --json`, plus its daily tokens and cost from omp's session logs. Use when setting up Oh My Pi or when an account shows "No usage reported". |
| [openai](providers/openai/README.md) | Track your OpenAI API organization's spend for the last 30 days, per line item, with an organization Admin API key. Use when setting up OpenAI or when it asks for an Admin key. |
| [opencode-go](providers/opencode-go/README.md) | Track OpenCode Go rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly usage from the opencode.ai usage API, or from the local opencode database when no API key is set. Also shows today's tokens from opencode's own database. Use when its numbers look off. |
| [openrouter](providers/openrouter/README.md) | Track your OpenRouter credit balance (total credits minus usage, in USD) with an OpenRouter API key. Use when setting up OpenRouter or when its key is rejected. |
| [vercel-gateway](providers/vercel-gateway/README.md) | Show your Vercel AI Gateway credit balance in dollars, using an AI Gateway API key stored in the Keychain or an environment variable. Use when setting up Vercel Gateway or when the connection test fails. |
| [warp](providers/warp/README.md) | Track Warp's monthly AI credits and add-on credits with a Warp API key. Use when setting up Warp or when its key is rejected. |
| [windsurf](providers/windsurf/README.md) | Track Windsurf's daily and weekly quota, or its message and flow-action allowances, from the plan the Windsurf app saves locally. Use when setting up Windsurf or when its numbers look old. |
| [zai](providers/zai/README.md) | Track the Z.ai / Zhipu GLM Coding Plan 5-hour, weekly and MCP quotas, from a saved key or Claude Code's settings. Use when setting up Z.ai or when it shows "Key needed". |

## Features, by context

Each feature sits in the bounded context that owns its question ([CANONICAL_MODEL §7](architecture/CANONICAL_MODEL.md#7--the-contexts-and-the-modules-that-implement-them)).

| Context | Doc | What it's for |
|---|---|---|
| activity | [notch](features/activity/notch/README.md) | Show quota and live Claude Code session state (working, subagents, needs you, done) in the MacBook notch, or a virtual notch on other displays. Use when turning on Notch Live Activity or when it shows nothing. |
| activity | [session-hooks](features/activity/session-hooks/README.md) | Let Claude Code push live session events to ClaudeBar through hooks, for Started/Finished notifications, the session indicator in the popover and menu bar, and the notch. Use when turning on session tracking or when it stays silent. |
| alerting | [notify](features/alerting/notify/README.md) | Send quota to your iPhone through the Notify! app, as a Lock Screen Live Activity, a Lock Screen widget gauge and a Home Screen widget. Use when linking a device or when a surface doesn't appear. |
| alerting | [quota-alerts](features/alerting/quota-alerts/README.md) | Get a notification when a login's quota falls below a percentage you pick, sooner than the built-in 20%. Use when setting up quota alerts or when one doesn't arrive. |
| alerting | [recap-alerts](features/alerting/recap-alerts/README.md) | Post the weekly recap to your Slack or JSON webhooks each week — the same numbers the All page's Weekly Recap card reads, sent once when your calendar's week turns. Use when the recap doesn't arrive or you want to stop it. |
| alerting | [status-alerts](features/alerting/status-alerts/README.md) | The notification ClaudeBar sends when a login's quota gets worse — running low, critically low, depleted — and how a webhook can send it too. Use when a status notification arrives twice, never, or under the wrong name. |
| alerting | [touch-bar](features/alerting/touch-bar/README.md) | Show live quota gauges on a MacBook Pro Touch Bar in every app, or feed BetterTouchTool, MTMR and scripts from ~/.claudebar/status.json. Use on Touch Bar Macs or when wiring quota into another tool. |
| alerting | [webhooks](features/alerting/webhooks/README.md) | Send ClaudeBar's quota alerts and status alerts to a Slack channel or a URL you own, as a Slack message or a JSON body. Use when wiring quota into Slack, a script or a service, or when a webhook says Failed. |
| app | [menu-bar](features/app/menu-bar/README.md) | Show quota percentage and reset countdown for up to three providers right in the menu bar, one or two windows each, single-line or stacked. Use when choosing what the menu bar label shows. |
| app | [popover-title](features/app/popover-title/README.md) | Replace the "ClaudeBar" title at the top of the popover with a name of your own, such as your team's or your own. Use when renaming the popover header or putting it back. |
| app | [themes](features/app/themes/README.md) | Pick a built-in theme (System, Light, Dark, CLI, Christmas, Pop, Platformer) or import an iTerm2 .itermcolors scheme to match your terminal. Use when changing how the popover, menu bar and Settings look. |
| app | [url-schemes](features/app/url-schemes/README.md) | Drive ClaudeBar from Raycast, Alfred, Shortcuts, BetterTouchTool or a terminal with claudebar://open, claudebar://refresh, claudebar://settings, claudebar://use and claudebar://show-anyway. Use when scripting ClaudeBar. |
| in-use | [in-use](features/in-use/README.md) | Choose which Claude or Codex login new terminal sessions start with — switch by hand, get a nudge when it runs low, or let ClaudeBar switch. Use when you have personal and work logins and want the next `claude` on the one with room. |
| leaderboard | [leaderboard](features/leaderboard/README.md) | Join the ClaudeBar Leaderboard with a username, share daily token totals from Claude, Codex, Mistral, Oh My Pi or OpenCode, and see your rank. Use when joining, changing what you share, or leaving. |
| monitoring | [all-providers](features/monitoring/all-providers/README.md) | See every provider's quota at once in the popover's All tab — a card each with the quota that runs out first, or a row of bars per quota. Use when choosing which assistant to keep working with, or to make the popover open on All. |
| monitoring | [forecast](features/monitoring/forecast/README.md) | The line on a quota card that says whether the window lasts until it resets at the pace it has been spent, and when it runs out if not. Use when reading a quota card's hourglass line, or when a card shows none. |
| monitoring | [rest-when-empty](features/monitoring/rest-when-empty/README.md) | Let a product rest while every login has run out — it stays in the popover and the menu bar, dimmed and labelled RESTING, until a refresh shows room again. Its switch stays yours. Use when an empty product keeps taking your attention. |
| providers | [custom](features/providers/custom/README.md) | Add a provider ClaudeBar doesn't ship by describing it in JSON — an API with your key, a CLI or a file — with Add Provider or Import in Settings, no script needed. Use when a service's usage is one HTTP call or one command away. |
| providers | [extensions](features/providers/extensions/README.md) | Add your own quota source to ClaudeBar with a manifest.json and a script that prints JSON, in ~/.claudebar/extensions/. Use when writing an extension or when one doesn't show up. |
| providers | [multi-account](features/providers/multi-account/README.md) | Track more than one Claude or Codex login side by side — sign in with your browser or choose a signed-in folder, name each account, pin them to the menu bar, and sign in again when a session expires. Use when you have personal and work accounts. |
| providers | [quota-pools](features/providers/quota-pools/README.md) | See how much room your logins of one product have together — "340% left across 3 logins" under the account chips in the popover. Use when you keep several logins and want the family's total at a glance. |
| quota | [status-colors](features/quota/status-colors/README.md) | How ClaudeBar colors a quota healthy, warning, critical or depleted, the optional warning when a quota will run out before it resets, and custom status colors and High Contrast. Use when a color looks wrong or hard to read. |
| usage-history | [daily-usage](features/usage-history/daily-usage/README.md) | Daily usage cards in the popover show today's estimated cost, tokens and working time against yesterday, read from local Claude Code (and Mistral Vibe, Oh My Pi or OpenCode) session logs. Use when the cards are missing or the numbers look off. |
| usage-history | [insights](features/usage-history/insights/README.md) | Below the daily usage chart, the popover reads a login's last year — a heatmap of a cell a day, shaded by how full it was, and the model mix: which models you lean on, largest first. Use when the insights are missing or a number looks off. |
| usage-history | [recap](features/usage-history/recap/README.md) | A Weekly Recap card on the popover's All page adds up the week across every provider — the total in dollars or tokens, the split by provider, the top model, the biggest day, cache savings, against the week before. Use when it is missing or looks off. |
